Repository evidence:
Section: What This Repository Is

kirolossedra is the special same-name repository GitHub renders as the account's public profile README.

Its purpose is identity and technical self-presentation rather than application execution.

The page includes:

a greeting;

animated name text;

profile-view tracking;

a short engineering identity statement;

a technology familiarity icon strip;

GitHub streak statistics.

Section: Technical Elements > Markdown

Markdown provides the document structure and headings.

Section: Technical Elements > Dynamic Typing SVG

readme-typing-svg.demolab.com renders an animated typing effect for the displayed name.

Section: Technical Elements > Profile View Counter

A Komarev badge endpoint renders a profile-view count.

Section: Technical Elements > GitHub Streak Statistics

github-readme-streak-stats.herokuapp.com generates a dynamic contribution-streak image.

Section: Skills Demonstrated > Developer Profile Presentation

GitHub profile README configuration — strong evidence.

Markdown — strong evidence.

HTML embedded in Markdown — strong evidence.

External badge/image integration — strong evidence.

Visual developer branding — moderate evidence.

Longitudinal profile maintenance — strong evidence.

Section: Evidence Boundary for Technology Icons

The skill icon strip names many technologies.

Within this repository, that is evidence of self-presented familiarity.

The portfolio corpus uses code/configuration evidence from other repositories when answering implementation questions about those technologies.

That distinction preserves the value of the profile without turning a badge list into implementation evidence.

Section: Capability Developed

Earlier repositories primarily preserve project code. Here, the GitHub account itself becomes intentionally presented through a persistent, curated README.

Section: Historical Significance

kirolossedra provides a useful non-code signal in the chronology: by early 2023, the GitHub presence itself was being treated as a portfolio surface.

Its later updates show that the public technical identity continued to be revised as the underlying project portfolio evolved.

Section: Overall Repository Narrative

kirolossedra is the account's GitHub profile README repository.

It combines Markdown, embedded HTML, animated SVG text, profile-view tracking, a technology-icon strip, and dynamic contribution statistics into a compact public developer profile. The repository is personally maintained over several years, making it evidence of portfolio curation and technical self-presentation rather than a software implementation project.
